notes.title: ⚠️🙀 Hotfix Version: 1.2 🙀⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]😻Hello cat lovers!😻[/h2]

[u][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievement[/b] - before the last achievement could not be obtained, but now you can;) If you completed the game, you can get it just by continuing the game and going through the last stage again.
[*] [b]Button control[/b] - improved room and UI navigation
[*] [b]Time format in research room[/b] - fixed display of mission types timer

Good luck, have fun captain!

notes.title: ⚠️🙀 Hotfix Version: 1.1 🙀⚠️
notes.content:
[h2]😻Hello cat lovers!😻[/h2]

First of all, thank you very much for your interest in the project!
To date, we have already collected [b]1000+ wishlists[/b] and sold [b]100+ copies[/b] at a [b]33% discount![/b]

Thank you so much for all your feedback, we hear you!
Therefore, we have released an update with fixes and features.

[u][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]UI[/b] - now we do not hide the panels when the camera approaches and enters the rooms
[*] [b]Solar panels[/b] - when buying a new solar panel, the previous one will be automated
[*] [b]Navigation[/b] - improved room navigation
[*] [b]Control room[/b] - now the cat-robot turns in the report on the completion of stage 17+ correctly
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] - now the training starts at a convenient moment
[*] [b]Ultrawide resolutions🤍🤍🤍[/b] - now the mod-display in the window has been changed, you can change the window to the size you need
[/list]

Thanks for your playtests, let's improve together, cats!😽
Good luck, have fun captain! 

[i]P.S. don't try to change the application window to other aspect ratio than 16:9... please, we are working on it.[/i]


=^_^= Meow-meow =^_^=

notes.title: Catellite-609: feline space adventure Will Be Available in Chinese!
notes.content:
Hello Cat and Space Lovers!

We’ve been overwhelmed by the positive love and reception for [b]DEMO Catellite-609: feline space adventure[/b] release! Thank you all so much for your support of the weird and wonderful!

We are super proud to announce that Catellite-609: feline space adventure will be support [b]Chinese[/b] languages!

In addition to that, we have also fixed many bugs to incorporate more hints and aid player direction.

That’s all for now! Please enjoy [b]Catellite-609: feline space adventure[/b] and add us to your [b]wishlist[/b]!
